readme.markdown:
# fst

Platform management for [fleetstreet](https://fleetstreet.ai) — license your creative work to AI, on your terms. Tenant admin, analytics, AI licensing, compliance evidence, support tickets - from the terminal.

## Install

```bash
npm install -g fleetstreet-cli
```

## Quick Start

```bash
# Login with your SuperAdmin API key
fst login --key YOUR_SA_API_KEY

# Platform dashboard
fst stats

# Revenue metrics
fst revenue

# Signup funnel
fst funnel

# List all tenants
fst tenants

# View a tenant
fst tenant show TENANT_ID

# Support tickets
fst tickets
fst ticket show TKT-abc123

# Chat with τAI h-conductor
fst tai "show me open P0 bugs" --dept dev

# AI Licensing (A2A copyright moat)
fst licensing harbourlight               # licensing overview for a creator
fst licensing harbourlight register ID   # register a work (image, writing, video, or track)
fst licensing harbourlight issue ID      # issue a scoped AI licence (view|derivative|train)
fst licensing harbourlight access-log    # provable access log (granted + blocked)

# Video works (footage)
fst videos harbourlight                  # list video works
fst videos harbourlight create "Title" --set videoUrl=https://...  # create (then register + license)

# Voice consent registry (voice works)
fst voice-consents harbourlight          # list actor consents
fst voice-consents harbourlight create --actor "Name" --email a@x.com --scopes read,summarise
fst voice-consents harbourlight revoke ID --reason "..."   # blocks future licence issuance

# Compliance evidence
fst compliance                           # snapshot (posture + frameworks + A2A events)
fst compliance posture                   # CISO posture score (0-100)
fst compliance frameworks eu-ai-act      # framework assessment
fst compliance audit-events --filter blocked
fst compliance export --format json      # export the OCSF audit log

# Full reference
fst help
```

## Features

- **Dashboard** - tenant counts, user stats, post/order totals
- **Revenue** - MRR, ARR, platform fees, payouts
- **Funnel** - signup → verified ($1) → active → paying
- **Tenants** - list, view, suspend, activate
- **Support** - tickets, reply, close
- **τAI Chat** - talk to h-conductor (6 departments: dev, devops, bizintel, compliance, helpdesk, fixer)
- **AI Licensing** - register works (images, writing, music), issue/revoke per-use AI licences, provable access log (the A2A copyright moat)
- **Compliance** - posture score, framework assessment (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, SOC 2, Colorado SB24-205, GDPR), OCSF audit-event stream + export

## Compliance-for-agents parity

The same AI-licensing and compliance surface is exposed to **per-creator agents** over the
[remote MCP server](https://mcp.fleetstreet.ai/sse) (`mcp.fleetstreet.ai`, v1.3.1, 46 tools). An
agent authenticated with a creator-scoped `fsk_` key gets read-only `fleetstreet_compliance`,
`fleetstreet_compliance_posture`, `fleetstreet_compliance_frameworks`, `fleetstreet_compliance_audit_events`
and `fleetstreet_compliance_export` tools — a per-creator mirror of the `fst compliance` commands here
(which run platform-wide via the SuperAdmin API). Same evidence, two front doors: this CLI for
platform operators, the remote MCP for a creator's own agent.

## Config

```bash
fst login --local --key YOUR_KEY    # saves to .fst/config.json (project-local)
fst login --key YOUR_KEY            # saves to ~/.fst/config.json (global)
fst config                          # show which config is active
```

Local config overrides global. Add `.fst/` to your `.gitignore`.

## Agent Integration

Add to your CLAUDE.md or agent instructions:

```
## fleetstreet Admin
Use the fst CLI for platform management.
Key is in .fst/config.json (auto-loaded).
Run fst --help for full reference.
```

## JSON Output

All commands support `--json` for machine-readable output:

```bash
fst stats --json
fst tenants --json
fst tickets --json
```

## Documentation

- [fleetstreet](https://fleetstreet.ai)
- [Roadmap](https://buggazi.com/roadmap.html?tenant=fleetstreet)

toolsPreview.name: fleetstreet_signup
toolsPreview.description: Create a new fleetstreet portfolio site. Requires the human's email and a portfolio/studio name: a welcome + activation email is sent to them (card required via Stripe to start the 7-day free trial, nothing charged during it). Returns an API key (shown once) and unlocks all fleetstreet tools in this session immediately. Ask the human for their email and portfolio name before calling.
